notes.title: Update for Web Designer 12 Premium!
notes.content:
[h1]Important changes in version 12.6.3.49884 compared to version 12.0.1.45290[/h1]

The new update for Web Designer Premium provides you with many new functions and improvements. Design your web pages with more power, individuality and ease!

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*]Maximum impression: The panorama photo slider widget displays your photos over the entire width of the page
[*]Over 100 new exciting customizable photo filters
[*]Discover the online library with more than 900,000 free stock images
[*]Even more, even smarter: Over a dozen smart forms for arrows, chevrons and lines
[/list]

[h1]New features and improvements[/h1]

[b]Content Catalog:[/b]
[list]
[*]Google Forms widget added to the Content Catalog. Create your own forms or choose a template for surveys and contact forms.
[*]For forms: Editor, reliable data storage, presentation and analysis.
[*]New option: The Content Catalog stays open after an element is selected
[/list]
 
[b]Smartshapes:[/b]
[list]
[*]New: Chevron, arrow, timeline
[*]New diagrams: Percentage ring, bar chart and column chart
[*]‘Smart’ handles are now automatically shown when you select a SmartShape with the Selector Tool
[*]Improved mouse pointers over SmartShape handles
[/list]
 
[b]Photo filters:[/b]
[list]
[*]Over 100 new photo grids
[*]New folder structure: Find the right layout for your website.
[*]Photo filter overlays: pattern, texture and transparency overlays Easy operation using right-click menu option
[/list]
 
[b]Text editing:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved text and list editing with expanded properties dialog
[*]Ligature support for countless fonts
[*]An easy to use Link to heading option (no anchor names required)
[*]Simplified vertical text alignment
[/list]
 
[b]Other improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved import and export of Word and PDF and PowerPoint files
[*]Grouped images can be exported with various settings
[*]New 'Change width of all pages' option
[*]Paste to multiple pages option
[/list]

[b]Fixed errors:[/b]
[list]
[*]No more complications as a result of moving bullet points.
[*]Art brush strokes don’t render while drawing.
[*]Resizing of embedded photos now works correctly
[*]Popup photos with reveal effects applied only appear once.
[/list]
